proposed_rules.trigger: A [region] node (FAQ/accordion answer text) appears as a top-level sibling of the root's main containers (sibling of the page body, footer, and cookie overlay) instead of nested inside its accordion question row.
proposed_rules.decision: Re-attach the region's text to the matching accordion row as its answer during Phase 2; never emit it as its own top-level section or block.
proposed_rules.rationale: The capture promotes absolutely-positioned accordion answer panels all the way out to the document root, here escaping every ancestor including the main content wrapper.
